ideas.title: AI Answer Visibility Tracker
ideas.pitch: See how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews mention your brand, and who they recommend instead.
ideas.problem: Buyers now ask AI assistants for vendor shortlists. Most marketing teams have no idea whether they're named, what's said about them, or which sources the answers cite.
ideas.how: Run a fixed prompt set (category, comparison and problem queries) on a schedule across AI APIs. Extract brand mentions, sentiment, position and cited URLs with structured outputs. Track share of voice over time.
ideas.who: B2B SaaS and industrial marketing teams, SEO/AEO agencies

ideas.title: AEO Content Gap Finder
ideas.pitch: Find the questions AI assistants answer about your category without citing you, and get briefs to fix it.
ideas.problem: Classic keyword tools don't show which pages AI answers pull from, or which questions you're missing.
ideas.how: Combine Search Console queries, 'People also ask' style question mining and AI answer citations. Cluster with embeddings, score gaps against your existing pages, and generate content briefs.

ideas.title: AI Crawler & llms.txt Audit
ideas.pitch: One-click check: can GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended reach your content? Generates an llms.txt.
ideas.problem: Sites often block AI crawlers by accident (robots.txt, WAF rules) or never decide on a policy at all.
ideas.how: Fetch robots.txt, test user agents against key URLs, detect WAF blocks and JS-only rendering, then output a policy recommendation plus a generated llms.txt.

ideas.title: Call-to-CRM Agent
ideas.pitch: Sales call transcript in, MEDDIC fields, next steps and follow-up email out, written straight to the CRM.
ideas.problem: Reps skip CRM updates after calls, so pipeline data and forecasts go stale.
ideas.how: Take transcripts from Zoom, Gong or Fireflies via webhook. Claude extracts MEDDIC/BANT fields, risks and next steps with evidence quotes. A human-approve step in Slack, then a HubSpot or Pipedrive update.

ideas.title: RFP & Security Questionnaire Agent
ideas.pitch: Draft answers to RFPs and security questionnaires from your own docs, with citations, in minutes instead of days.
ideas.problem: Questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, custom RFPs) eat days of SE and security team time and stall deals.
ideas.how: RAG over policies, past answers and product docs. Claude drafts each answer with cited sources and a confidence score. Low-confidence answers are routed to an owner. Export back to Excel or Word.
ideas.who: SaaS sales engineers, security and compliance teams

ideas.title: Account Research Brief
ideas.pitch: Type a company domain and get a one-page pre-meeting brief: what they do, likely priorities, recent news and talking points.
ideas.problem: Reps walk into first calls under-prepared, or spend 30 minutes researching each account.
ideas.how: Crawl the website, careers page and public news with web search. Claude summarizes into a fixed brief template mapped to your ICP and value props.

ideas.title: Google Ads Wasted-Spend Detector
ideas.pitch: An LLM reads your search-terms report and flags irrelevant queries burning budget, with ready-to-upload negative keywords.
ideas.problem: Broad match and Performance Max surface thousands of search terms. Nobody reviews them, and 10–30% of spend often goes to irrelevant queries.
ideas.how: Pull search terms via the Google Ads API (or CSV). Classify relevance against your offer with structured outputs, estimate wasted spend, cluster into negative-keyword lists, and export to Ads Editor.

ideas.title: Consent Compliance Crawler
ideas.pitch: Crawls your site like a new EU visitor and reports every tag and cookie that fires before consent.
ideas.problem: Misconfigured CMPs and Consent Mode v2 setups leak data before consent, which creates regulatory risk and inflates or breaks ad data.
ideas.how: Headless browser visits key pages in deny/accept scenarios, records network requests and cookies, checks Consent Mode v2 signals, and maps violations to vendors with screenshots.

ideas.title: UTM Governance Linter
ideas.pitch: A UTM builder with enforced naming rules, plus a linter that finds the messy campaign tags breaking your GA4 channel reports.
ideas.problem: 'Facebook' vs 'facebook' vs 'fb' splits data, and bad UTMs push traffic into Unassigned in GA4.
ideas.how: Shared taxonomy config, a builder UI, and a GA4 API scan that groups near-duplicate source/medium/campaign values and suggests fixes and channel-group rules.

ideas.title: B2B Pricing & Quote Configurator
ideas.pitch: A template for interactive product configurators that output a quote range and a qualified lead, not a 'contact us' dead end.
ideas.problem: Complex B2B products hide pricing, and buyers who want a ballpark leave.
ideas.how: JSON-driven options, rules and price tables. Live quote range, PDF summary, and the lead plus configuration pushed to the CRM. Brandable per client.
ideas.who: Manufacturers, industrial distributors, SaaS with tiered pricing

ideas.title: Event & Webinar ROI Calculator
ideas.pitch: Prove (or kill) trade shows and webinars: cost per meeting, pipeline influenced and payback, before and after the event.
ideas.problem: Events are among the biggest B2B budget lines and the least measured.
ideas.how: Inputs for costs, booth traffic, meetings and conversion rates, with benchmarks by industry. Pre-event targets vs post-event actuals, exportable for finance.

ideas.title: Cost-of-Delay Calculator
ideas.pitch: Shows prospects what waiting another quarter costs them. The calculator that unsticks deals.
ideas.problem: The real competitor in B2B deals is 'do nothing'. Champions need a number to create urgency.
ideas.how: Value drivers per product (hours saved, revenue lift, risk avoided), monthly cost of inaction, and a shareable link or PDF for the champion's internal business case.
